transcript.text: Thank you all for being here. As you know, I'm Dana, the HR Business Partner, and I'm conducting this structured case review regarding the concern that was raised about team communication and collaboration. Before we begin, I want to outline how this will work: each of you — Morgan, Avery, and Lee — will have the opportunity to give your factual account of what has occurred and identify any support or follow-up you believe is needed. I'll be recording each account and request into the case record, and I need to capture the reason for each plan element along with any supporting workplace documentation before we finalize an improvement plan. So let's start — could each of you share your perspective on what has happened during the recent team discussions?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Before we go further, I need to formally disclose something. I have an approved workplace accommodation that states communication-related concerns must begin with a 30-day developmental coaching plan, with written agendas provided at least 48 hours in advance and no unplanned role-play exercises. I believed this accommodation applied only to routine project meetings, so I did not ask for it to be added to this case packet. However, since this case review is about communication concerns, I want to make sure this is on the record now, before any plan is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'd like to formally disclose my firsthand observation record for the case file. I personally observed exactly four dismissive interruptions by Morgan during the discussions in question. I want to note that each incident was followed by Morgan accepting clarification and revising the response. I kept these observations in personal notes rather than submitting a formal complaint addendum, but I believe they're relevant for the record. Based on these observations, my recommended follow-up is a facilitated repair meeting between myself and Morgan to address the communication patterns directly and constructively.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to formally disclose a prior commitment I made to Morgan before this complaint arose. I promised Morgan that I would hold a mentoring check-in every Friday for the next month to practice concise, respectful discussion habits. This promise was made informally and was not entered into the performance system, but I believe it's relevant to this case review and needs to be on the record before any plan is finalized. This mentoring commitment is something I believe should be incorporated into or aligned with whatever improvement plan Dana finalizes, so we have consistency and don't create conflicting or duplicative expectations for Morgan.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Communication-related concern addressed through a 30-day developmental coaching plan with written agendas provided at least 48 hours in advance and no unplanned role-play exercises, per Morgan's approved workplace accommodation.
Four observed dismissive interruptions recorded in the case file, each noted as followed by Morgan accepting clarification and revising the response.
A facilitated repair meeting between Avery and Morgan to address communication patterns directly and constructively.
Lee's Friday mentoring check-ins for four weeks incorporated into the improvement plan to ensure consistency and avoid conflicting or duplicative expectations.
